title: Abbas ke baba ki
body:
masjid e kufa se lekar taaba khaake karbala
qatl sajdon mein hua hai mustafa ki aal ka
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke baba ki jabeen khoon se tar hai
dooba hua gham mein bani hashim ka qamar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke chehre pe hai zainab ki nigahein
ye poochti ho jaise mera baba kidhar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa pahonchi hai zehra ki shahadat bhi ali tak
kufe pe bhi lagta hai madine ka asar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal beti pe barsenge inhi galiyon mein pathar
in galiyon se baba ke janaze ka guzar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha se ab jeena hai ye poochlo zainab
kufe ke yateemon ko yateemi ki khabar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaqa pe liye jaate hai taboot ali ka
humraah e pidar aakhri beton ka safar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
<<DIVIDER>>
phaila hua mabood hi ka khoon hai akbar
jis khoon se rangeen hua mabood ka ghar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
author: Hasnain Akbar
